# G1 Review Checklist: Missed Connection Benefit

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of the missed connection spec for the G1 signers (Business owner, AI lead): eligibility, calculation and shared limit, minimum connection time, double payment, human oversight and routing, letters
**Created**: 2026-11-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · requirements in `docs/requirements/*.yaml` (REQ-F-001, REQ-F-032..039, REQ-B-012/013)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Eligibility Rules

- [ ] CHK001 Is it specified whether any length of inbound delay qualifies, or whether a minimum inbound delay applies, when the delay causes the missed connection? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-006, REQ-F-036]
- [ ] CHK002 Is "booked on a single ticket" defined with the evidence that proves it (same booking reference, through-checked baggage, one e-ticket)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements defined for a connection between two airports in the same city (airport change) or a terminal change? [Gap, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK004 Is it stated that the late check-in exclusion refers to the inbound leg, the onward leg, or both? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the behaviour defined when the flight status source is unavailable or returns no cause for the inbound delay? [Gap, Exception Flow, REQ-F-034]

## Calculation and Shared Limit

- [ ] CHK006 Is "reasonable" quantified for accommodation and meals (per-night or per-day caps), as it is for ticket class? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "until the next available departure" defined, including when the customer chooses a later flight than the next available one? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the treatment of the unused original onward ticket specified (refund received from the airline offset or not)? [Gap, Spec §FR-007, FR-008]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "journey" defined for the shared limit, in particular whether outward and return trips are separate journeys? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, REQ-F-038]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the scope of the clause 6.3 override limited to rebooked or new tickets, and stated in the requirement itself? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK011 Are deduction types (A or B) specified for each missed-connection deduction: limit cap, compensation offset, receipt rule, class above reasonable, already paid? [Completeness, REQ-F-020, Spec §User Story 1-3]

## Minimum Connection Time

- [ ] CHK012 Is the published minimum connection time source named, with how it is kept current and who owns it? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions, REQ-F-035]
- [ ] CHK013 Are domestic/international and terminal-specific minimum connection times addressed, or is one value per airport assumed? [Gap, REQ-F-035]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the booked connection time defined from scheduled times on the original booking (not actual times)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the outcome defined when the booked connection is exactly equal to the minimum connection time? [Edge Case, REQ-F-035]

## Double Payment

- [ ] CHK016 Does REQ-F-038 apply in both orders (missed connection claimed before or after travel delay), and is the change to travel delay assessment stated as a requirement? [Consistency, REQ-F-038, REQ-F-015]
- [ ] CHK017 Is "the same expense" defined (same receipt, same night, same amount) so overlap detection is testable? [Measurability, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK018 Is it specified how one claim that contains both travel delay and missed connection expenses is split under REQ-F-001 "or a combination"? [Gap, REQ-F-001]

## Human Oversight and Routing

- [ ] CHK019 Are routing outcomes stated for every non-qualifying reason in User Story 2 (rejection rows 5, investigation row 6) consistently with REQ-B-002 and REQ-B-011? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 2]
- [ ] CHK020 Is it explicit that REQ-B-001 to REQ-B-011 apply unchanged to the new claim type, including straight-through only within USD 1,000 with no deduction? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions, §ADLC Autonomy]
- [ ] CHK021 Is fraud screening (REQ-F-016) explicitly required for missed connection claims, including altered boarding-pass times? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK022 Does REQ-B-013 define what makes legs "ambiguous" well enough to be evaluated? [Measurability, REQ-B-013]

## Letters

- [ ] CHK023 Are the letter's required contents specified for each outcome (paid, partly paid, rejected for self-transfer, short connection, excluded cause)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, REQ-F-039]
- [ ] CHK024 Is Compliance approval of the new template stated as a dependency with its gate (G4)? [Dependency, Spec §User Story 4]

## Acceptance Criteria and Measurability

- [ ] CHK025 Are SC-001 to SC-003 / KPI-07 to KPI-09 still placeholders, and is a date or owner set for confirming the figures? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria, docs/kpis.yaml]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the source for KPI-08 (goodwill payments outside the claims system) available and owned? [Assumption, docs/kpis.yaml]
- [ ] CHK027 Is each new threshold (eligibility, connection time, leg attribution, duplicate expense) defined precisely enough to compute, and is 12 golden cases enough to show 0.95? [Measurability, Spec §Eval Thresholds, §Ground Truth]
- [ ] CHK028 Do the acceptance scenario amounts (USD 320, 150, 1,300, 300 + 350) agree with the shared-limit and offset rules? [Consistency, Spec §User Stories 1, 3]

## Non-Functional, Data and Dependencies

- [ ] CHK029 Do REQ-N-001 (decision package p95 ≤ 10 minutes) and REQ-N-003 (cost per claim) hold for multi-leg claims with extra flight status look-ups, or need restating? [Gap, Non-Functional]
- [ ] CHK030 Is "no new data category" validated for boarding passes (barcode data, booking references of other passengers)? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK031 Is the new policy clause 3.7 wording, and its approval outside this system, recorded as a dependency for release? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items left open at G1 can be accepted as conditions by the signers, or answered with `/speckit-clarify`
- Items numbered sequentially for easy reference
